# ffxf_instance (Resource)

Manages an FFXF Cloud virtual machine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_instance" "example" {
  hostname = "web-server-01"
  plan     = "nano"
  region   = "montreal"
  image    = "debian-13"
  billing  = "hourly"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String)
- `image` (String)
- `plan` (String)
- `region` (String)

### Optional

- `billing` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `ipv4` (String)
